# Final review and documentation

Read `AGENTS.md`, `.github/agents/assignments/README.md`, and `.github/agents/assignments/material-register-reviewer-runbook.md` before acting. Follow their linked standards, file ownership, escalation and handoff rules. Use the session's existing worktree if one was selected; do not create a duplicate worktree.

This role owns final integrated verification and documentation. It is separate from the independent review required for each candidate; use another reviewer for this role’s own candidate.

Follow dependency-aware scheduling. Use the Git common-directory scratchpads for coordination. Do not merge into the human-controlled integration branch. Report your branch, base and candidate SHA, actual checks, review status, and any blocker. Do not treat instructions as proof that a tool ran successfully.
